title: Import local folders
subtitle: Thunderbird (mbox or Maildir). Messages are copied into “On this computer”; nothing is changed in Thunderbird.
choose: Choose your Thunderbird profile folder (or a folder that contains your mailboxes). Close Thunderbird first so its files don't change during the import. Messages deleted in Thunderbird are not imported.
keepUsing: You can keep using Envelope. If the import is interrupted, run it again: messages already imported are not duplicated.
noFolders: No mail folders (mbox or Maildir) found here. Choose the Thunderbird profile folder or the one that contains your mailboxes.
